name: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd
issuerLegalStructure: Bankruptcy-remote special purpose debt issuance vehicle
tokenholderEntitlement: Contractual security-linked debt security tracking economic total return of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd (NYSE: BABA) ADS. Does not convey direct company share ownership, shareholder voting rights, or direct claim on underlying Chinese enterprise assets.
custodyAndBacking: Underlying equity shares held in segregated custodial trust accounts with an SEC-registered US custodian (Citibank, N.A. depositary). Full 1:1 economic backing verification conducted daily.
corporateActionPolicy: Economic dividends and cash distributions are reflected on-chain via Chainlink multiplier adjustments and net cash credits. Stock splits adjust token multiplier proportionally without mutating raw on-chain token balances.
transferRestrictions: Subject to issuer freeze and transfer restrictions in restricted jurisdictions. Verified native identity on Robinhood Chain mainnet.
oracleMethodology: Chainlink BABA/USD Reference Feed (Heartbeat: 86,400s). Reverify official Chainlink reference directory and live contract before credit activation.
verifiedBy: Levier Chinese Equities Data Audit (Robinhood Chain 4663)
